notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Thanks to all, who have gotten around to playing Corvos Dynasty! Your feedback has been constructive in spotting what areas have trouble and what can be improved. Here is the first wave of bug fixes.

[h2]CHANGES[/h2]
[list]
[*] If you fail a stealth section 3 or more times you can choose to skip it.
[*] Some dialogue has been modified to give the player a better sense of direction.
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] The guard will now go back to his original spot after spotting the player in chapter 1
[*] chapter 3 had a major sequence break allowing you to skip a dungeon and character, that has now been patched.
[*] chests in the sunken forest have been updated with better logic.
[*] quests no longer break in chapter 3
[*] characters would sometimes turn invisible in cutscenes, this has been patched in a few places
[*] The map should be less likely to fail to load an area in Corvos
[/list]

notes.title: Corvos Dynasty Release
notes.notes:
I am happy to say Corvos Dynasty is finally released! I hope you guys enjoy playing the game as much as I enjoyed making it.

I have lots of additional content I plan on adding to the game too! So I'm always interested in feedback and your experience with the game.

-Dylan Blake

notes.notes: Build your heroes, loot the kingdom, and discover rare treasures. Corvos Dynasty is an RPG inspired by old-school classics. Will you be the legendary hero who saves the princess or the conquerer who burns the monarchy to the ground?
